name: 3D Diffuser Actor
summary: The model lifts 2D visual features into 3D scene tokens using depth, then runs a 3D relative-attention denoising transformer that diffuses end-effector poses in SE(3). Combining 3D grounding with the multimodality of diffusion, it set state of the art on RLBench and CALVIN at release.
innovation: 3D relative attention between scene tokens and the noisy action, giving translation-equivariant reasoning.
Diffusion over SE(3) poses rather than joint-space deltas.
matters: Showed the 3D-policy and generative-policy branches are complementary rather than competing.
limits: Requires depth and is heavier than 2D policies at inference.
lineage: PerAct's 3D grounding fused with Diffusion Policy's generative action head.
